correctness.rationale: At length N a missing return distance d is forbidden iff d+1≤N. Justification of the language at an edge needs a small clarification: to extend a word with leading or trailing zeros, first choose allowed distances longer than these end runs (D is unbounded), then use repetitions of distance 1; for an all-zero word choose one sufficiently long allowed gap. Thus the proposed language is correct. Renewal gives F_N(u)−1=q^N A_N at u=log λ. Over [u,log 2], the d=1 term gives |F_N'|≥1/2 and so u_N−u=O(q^N). The derivative correction is O(Nq^N) and the second derivative is uniformly bounded, giving the specified error. Strict drop follows directly by subtracting q_N^N from the renewal sum when τ_N=0; (10^(N−1))^Z witnesses strict inclusion. For N=1,2,3 the covers are full, with the first drop at N=3→4. Uniform recurrence yields exactly the continuous image of the hull; a tail collision would splice a second expansion of 1, and an isolated value would force infinitely many repeated visits to its open fiber. Linear factor complexity gives O(r) intervals of diameter O(q^r), proving dimension zero. No injectivity of the entire hull or inference from finite tests is needed.
